coverageNotes: Counter maintenance is supplied and checked as setup. Does not independently test OCC, rollback design, migration/backfill, edits/deletes, or production timing.

questions.context:
Convex 1.44.0. Tickets are append-only and all inserts go through `createTicket`. That mutation inserts the ticket and updates one `ticketCounts` row for its organization in the same transaction. The counter equals the total number of tickets. An organization without tickets has no counter row.

The schema contains:
```ts
tickets: defineTable({ orgId: v.string(), title: v.string(), status: v.string() })
  .index("by_orgId", ["orgId"]),
ticketCounts: defineTable({ orgId: v.string(), count: v.number() })
  .index("by_orgId", ["orgId"]),
```

`getTicketCount` is a query with `args: { orgId: v.string() }`.
questions.question: Which handler returns the exact count while keeping the number of documents read independent of the number of tickets?

options.rationale: This counts correctly but iterates every matching ticket. Avoiding collect does not make the read constant-size.
The maintained counter supplies the exact total through one indexed document, or zero when absent.
This counts correctly but collects every matching ticket, so document reads grow with ticket history.
This bounds reads but returns 100 when the exact total exceeds 100.
